question: Should OpenClaw add a backward-compatible acknowledgment-reaction pool, and should selection be deterministic/random or model-driven from message content?
rationale: The alternatives materially differ in configuration surface, latency, cost, determinism, and channel compatibility, so source evidence cannot establish the intended product behavior.

options.title: Add deterministic pool
options.body: Keep ackReaction as the fallback and add an optional pool with a cheap documented selection strategy and channel-specific validation.

options.title: Keep one reaction
options.body: Retain the current singular account/channel/global contract and close the feature as unnecessary configuration surface.

options.title: Add contextual model choice
options.body: Introduce a pre-ack model or classifier hook and explicitly accept its additional latency, cost, and nondeterminism.

recommendation.title: Add deterministic pool
recommendation.body: Keep ackReaction as the fallback and add an optional pool with a cheap documented selection strategy and channel-specific validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes a shared user-facing configuration and agent/channel behavior contract, matching the repository's documented project decision ownership.
